claims.text: That same year, Eärnil, Captain of the Southern Army, avenged Minohtar, the King, and the others who died in the disaster of the Morannon by routing the Wainriders in the Battle of the Camp. The victorious Eärnil was thereafter granted the crown of Gondor.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), Unfinished Tales, "Cirion and Eorl and the Friendship of Gondor and Rohan", pp. 292-4
